observations.content: User supplied 12-turn preparation context for a later implementation task: add reporting and persistence of actual pi usage costs for observer and consolidator workers, including ephemeral and unsuccessful runs with valid usage; record worker-role/run identity in session ledger, include cost entries from all branches including abandoned branches in totals, ignore missing/malformed/non-finite/negative costs, surface total in status/footer UI, and add focused aggregation, invalid-entry, cost-handoff, and display tests.

Project reference describes observational-memory for pi, currently Phase A+B: parallel subprocess observers commit observations to branch-local ledger, deterministic compaction renders journey/map/observations, and background consolidator writes durable project `.memory/` topic files and journey.

Plan's locked architecture: bespoke child_process.spawn of recorded global pi sessions rather than subagents; one shared worker extension selected by OM_WORKER plus master orchestrator; vendor trimmed ledger modules; default-off per-session `/om` gate; orchestrator assigns unique observation timestamp IDs. Strong default model is anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, low thinking for observers and medium for consolidator.

Phase B design specifies oldest-first consolidation above poolTargetTokens, one consolidator at a time, and tombstones handed observations intersected with currently active observations only after clean worker exit; files persist across `/tree`, while ledger buffer is branch-local. Compaction waits only for observers and can skip wait when they cannot affect projection.

`.memory/JOURNEY.md` is the consolidator-maintained, descriptive, append-mostly project history, compressed at its target size, excluded from topic map and rendered verbatim first in compaction for orientation only.

Reference README documents `/om`, `/om:status`, `/om:compact`, `/om:consolidate`, namespaced observational-memory settings and PI_OM_PASSIVE; configurable defaults vary between PLAN and current src/config.ts, whose chunkTokens is 10000 and consolidateAtPoolTokens is 15000.

Reference implementation includes worker launch, observer result-file IPC, scoped consolidator tools, ledger folding/projection and token clocks, timestamp assignment, compaction trigger/hook, pool selection, status footer gauges and timeline, and tests across these components; implementation excerpts are context for the future task, not completed work assertions.
